principle_violations.reason: The Order class handles multiple responsibilities: managing items, calculating the total price, and processing payments.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate payment processing into a separate class, such as PaymentProcessor, and keep the Order class focused on order management.

principle_violations.reason: The pay method needs to be modified for any new payment type, violating the open/closed principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Use polymorphism to allow for new payment types without modifying the Order class. Create an interface for payment methods.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
